description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans .NET framework, specifically testing the resiliency of grain activation in scenarios with invalid or 'poison' directory entries. It verifies that the system can recover from stale entries and maintain activation constraints, including scenarios involving cross-silo forwarding.

classes.name: GrainLocatorActivationResiliencyTests
classes.description: Unit test class to verify Orleans' resiliency in handling invalid grain directory entries, including local and remote scenarios.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_LocalSilo
methods.description: Tests the system's ability to recover from a poison directory entry pointing to a non-existent activation within the same silo.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_RemoteSilo
methods.description: Tests cross-silo behavior where a poison directory entry causes forwarding from a secondary silo to a primary silo, verifying recovery logic.
